peers.name: architect
peers.purpose: Ask about the design when the ticket does not settle it.

commands:
pwd; ls -la; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -40; /var/folders/4g/s95glx9x6n71bq4hc08ly2gm0000gn/T/m2-await-Z8aWcx/bin/wf send architect --await-reply <<'WF_MSG'
Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or the queue. The ticket explicitly reserves that choice to you. Please specify client or queue and any required retry policy/idempotency constraints so I can write a short plan.
WF_MSG
turns.final: Awaiting the architect’s decision on client versus queue retries and any retry-policy constraints.

calls.text: Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or the queue. The ticket explicitly reserves that choice to you. Please specify client or queue and any required retry policy/idempotency constraints so I can write a short plan.

turns.final: Submitted the plan: queue-owned retries, with the shared client and batch path remaining single-attempt, plus bounded backoff, idempotency safeguards, and tests.

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Per the architect, implement retries in the queue; keep charge() in src/payments.ts and the shared HTTP client single-attempt so the batch path never retries. Classify transient failures for bounded queue retries with exponential backoff and jitter; do not retry permanent failures. Before enabling retries, establish payment-provider idempotency using one stable key per logical charge across attempts. Test transient recovery, exhausted retries, permanent failures, duplicate-charge prevention, and the batch path remaining single-attempt."}
